title: graph2otel / Self-Observability
description: Is graph2otel itself healthy: scrape and record outcomes, event lag, payload drift, checkpoint persistence, export-job outcomes, the cardinality limiter, Graph throttling and outbound HTTP. Generated by grafana/build_dashboard.py — edit grafana/boards/selfobs.py, not this JSON.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Prometheus datasource
list.description: Where graph2otel's OTLP metrics land after normalization.

list.name: loki_datasource
list.label: Loki datasource
list.description: Required by the log panels. Leave unset and they say so rather than looking broken.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: tenant_id is on every signal (#143). A single-tenant deployment with no tenant id configured stamps no label; select All.

panels.title: Read this before writing your own query

options.content:
**Metrics answer "how many"; logs answer "which one".** graph2otel puts bounded,
tenant-shaped aggregates on metrics and per-entity detail on the log twin (#112).
If a panel here cannot tell you *which* device or user, the Logs row at the bottom
can.

**Metric names are the OTLP→Prometheus normalized form** — dots become underscores
and unit/type suffixes are appended (`_total` on counters, `_seconds`, `_ratio`,
`_percent`). Every query on this dashboard is generated from
`spec/signal-catalog.json`, which is itself generated from what the collectors
actually emit, so a panel cannot name a metric that does not exist.

**LogQL: attributes are structured metadata, not stream labels.** Only
`service_name` is a stream label. `{event_name="entra.signin"}` matches **zero rows,
silently** — it is not an error. Always:

```logql
{service_name="graph2otel"} | event_name=`entra.signin` | status_error_code!=`0`
```

**Empty is often correct.** Several collectors are opt-in (blob ingest, beta Graph
surfaces, high-volume feeds) and several are empty on a healthy tenant. A blank panel
is not evidence of a broken pipeline.

panels.title: Blob ingest health and API drift
Microsoft API drift — a response no longer matches what a collector expects
Blob records: emitted as metrics vs gated
Current collector availability
panels.description: One current value-1 row per tenant and logical collector. collector_transport is the resolved collector transport, not the log-record ingest_transport.

targets.expr: max by (tenant_id, collector, collector_transport, state, reason) (graph2otel_collector_availability{tenant_id=~"$tenant",collector=~"$collector"})

panels.title: Collector availability by state
panels.description: Current logical-collector counts by bounded availability state. This is a snapshot, not a scrape-success or record-throughput count.

panels.title: Intentional collector absence
panels.description: Disabled and covered collectors are intentional absence, shown separately from runtime or startup failures.

targets.expr: max by (tenant_id, collector, collector_transport, state, reason) (graph2otel_collector_availability{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector", state=~"disabled|covered"})

panels.title: Collector availability failures
panels.description: Current permission-denied blocks, degraded runs, failed runs, and startup failures. This is deliberately separate from configured absence and subscription limitations.

targets.expr: max by (tenant_id, collector, collector_transport, state, reason) (graph2otel_collector_availability{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector", state=~"degraded|failed|startup_failed"})
max by (tenant_id, collector, collector_transport, state, reason) (graph2otel_collector_availability{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector", state="blocked", reason="permission_denied"})

panels.title: Subscription and capability limitations
panels.description: This non-failure view shows subscription and capability limitations: a partial license can keep a collector running with a reduced capability set, while an unavailable license blocks it. Exact omitted capabilities are available from the admin status, not labels.

targets.expr: max by (tenant_id, collector, collector_transport, state, reason) (graph2otel_collector_availability{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector", state="limited", reason="partial_license"})
max by (tenant_id, collector, collector_transport, state, reason) (graph2otel_collector_availability{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector", state="blocked", reason="license_unavailable"})

panels.title: Scrape success by collector
panels.description: 1 when the last reconciled run was empty or successful; 0 when it was partial or failed (including a recovered panic). A green tick is not evidence of data: several collectors succeed on an empty collection by design.

panels.title: Scrape staleness (seconds since last healthy result)
panels.description: Counts up from process start until the first empty or successful result, so a collector that has never been healthy shows a growing value rather than no series.

panels.title: Age of the latest completed scrape
panels.description: Wall-clock age of the latest completed run, whether it succeeded or failed.

panels.title: Scrape budget (duration / interval)
panels.description: At or above 1 a scrape takes as long as its own poll interval — no headroom, risk of overrun.

panels.title: Scrape error rate by error type
Checkpoint persist error rate
panels.description: The window succeeded but its high-water mark did not reach disk. The next tick still advances; the window is only re-polled after a restart.

panels.title: Collector runs by reconciled result
panels.description: Separates healthy-empty polls from successful data-bearing polls and from partial or failed runs.

panels.title: Source-record rate by outcome
panels.description: One source row counts once at each lifecycle boundary; fetched, mapped, and terminal outcomes overlap and are deliberately unstacked. This is not the number of OTEL metric points or log records.

panels.title: Dropped / errored source records
panels.description: Any nonzero value is record loss. `dropped` is a deliberate rejection such as a missing event timestamp; `errored` is decode or processing failure.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant_id, collector, ingest_transport, outcome) (rate(graph2otel_record_outcomes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector", outcome=~"dropped|errored"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Source-event lag at emission
panels.description: Source timestamp to graph2otel emission. It does not measure backend acceptance or OTLP delivery latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, tenant_id, collector, ingest_transport) (rate(graph2otel_event_lag_seconds_bucket{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant_id, collector, ingest_transport) (rate(graph2otel_event_lag_seconds_bucket{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Payload type mismatches
panels.description: Report-only payload drift. Labels contain only source-controlled field names and closed JSON types, never field values.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant_id, collector, ingest_transport, field, expected_type, actual_type) (rate(graph2otel_payload_type_mismatches_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant", collector=~"$collector"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Build info (process-wide)
panels.description: One series for the graph2otel process. Tenant selection does not apply: duplicating build identity per tenant would create misleading copies of the same process fact.

panels.title: Export jobs (Intune report exports, M365 audit query)
Active series by source metric (process-wide)
panels.description: Distinct series emitted per source metric across the shared process AFTER limiting — the series actually billed. Tenant selection does not apply.

panels.title: Series clipped, by mode (process-wide)
panels.description: mode=folded were summed into the `other` bucket; mode=dropped were discarded because the metric is not additive and a synthetic aggregate would be worse than the loss. Counts cover the shared process; tenant selection does not apply.

panels.title: Total active series (process-wide)
panels.description: Total distinct active series across the shared process during the last export interval. Tenant selection does not apply.

panels.title: Configured per-metric series limit (process-wide)
panels.description: One process-wide cardinality policy. Tenant selection does not apply.

panels.title: Graph-reported throttle budget consumed
panels.description: From the x-ms-throttle-limit-percentage response header, which is not sent on every 429 or every workload — an absent series does NOT mean the budget is healthy.

panels.title: Logs — which one, not how many (#162)
Blob diagnostic categories — which container, mapped or not
panels.description:
One record per diagnostic category found in the storage account, saying whether graph2otel has a mapper for it. An unmapped category is data arriving that nothing reads.

Needs a **Loki** datasource (selected above). Log attributes are Loki *structured metadata*, not stream labels: filter with `| event_name=…` after `{service_name="graph2otel"}`. A stream selector on an attribute matches zero rows silently (#90).

defaults.noValue: No rows. Either no Loki datasource is selected above, or nothing matched. Log attributes are structured metadata: filter with | attr=… after {service_name="graph2otel"}, never {attr="…"}.
